messages:
samira: Heads-up: we kicked off a 3% canary for the short-prefix-ttl + mini-aggregator changes that landed in last sprint. Goal: reduce fragmentation for seq<=48 and improve coalescer packing.
lin: Quick bench from the 24h replay (mixed-prod mix): p50 -14%, p95 -10%, p99 -20%. Token compute cost down ~9%. Biggest wins on quick-reply flows (conversational.quick-reply route).
ops-bot: Canary report: https://internal.redwood/bench/canary/1759998888
```
avg (shard mean):
- baseline p50 28ms -> canary p50 24ms
- baseline p95 140ms -> canary p95 126ms
- baseline p99 420ms -> canary p99 336ms
- cost / 1k tokens: $0.078 -> $0.071
- request error rate: 0.09% -> 0.095% (within noise)
```
darren: Nice. Any memory or queuing regressions on the GPU side?
lin: No sustained CUDA memory growth. We observed a small spike in pending-queue latency for a micro-shard for ~2m during ramp, but peak queue stayed <30ms. The mini-aggregator reduced tail batching fragmentation which explains the p99 drop.
maria: Can we get the exact canary config for audit? I need to update the rollout tracker and the product note.
samira: Config we used: 
```
canary:
  pct: 3
  ramp_schedule: 3 -> 25 -> 60 over 90m
  evaluation_window: 15m
  rollback_triggers:
    p99_absolute_increase_ms: 40
    p99_relative_increase_pct: 10
    error_rate_relative_increase_pct: 0.4
    sustained_queue_latency_ms: 30
```
lin: Also added a temporary fallback that routes requests with seq>64 to the stable kernel. Fallbacks activated automatically if memory or p99 trigger hits.
maria: Product blurb request: can you give me one short sentence + one stat for the weekly update?
darren: Draft: "Runtime change (short-prefix-ttl + mini-aggregator) reduces median latency by ~14% and p99 by ~20% on short-chat flows; token cost estimated down 9%."
maria: Perfect, will include that.
samira: We'll monitor dashboards (runtime.coalescer.*, runtime.kv_sieve.*) and PagerDuty for 2h. If no regressions we ramp to 60% then 100% later tonight. Thanks team. :rocket:
